text: Six-week trial of older adults: daily walks lowered blood pressure, only for those not on medication.
Coffee may boost memory, but so far that's only shown in mice given about eight cups daily.
A Chinese call-centre firm's home workers were 13% more productive, mainly because they took fewer breaks.
A new bridge trimmed northern commutes by about four minutes, measured during school holidays.
Small, mixed-quality trials hint vitamin D prevents colds, but only in people deficient in it.
A four-week reading app helped children with tutors recognize letters, but not understand stories.
Lab bees given ten times field pesticide doses took shorter foraging trips, but didn't die.
A four-day-week trial in volunteer firms, lacking a comparison group, cut weekly hours from 38 to 34.
